notes.title: Leap of Love teaser #1
notes.content:
Hi guys :)

For our first teaser I decided to talk to you about the map and [b]Attributes[/b] system in [b]Leap of Love[/b].

[h2]MAP[/h2]
The game world is represented by a map of a fantasy town and the lands surounding it. in the morning you can choose one of those locations to train in and in the afternoon if an event is available you can go to the corresponding location (otherwise you get a random event).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39103775/a911623cd777be7563125cf124751e836bf8139c.jpg[/img]

[h2]ATTRIBUTES[/h2]
To survive and seduce his beloved our hero, Kaheroux, will need to train and better himself in three areas of expertise or [b]Attributes[/b].

[b]Prowess[/b] is a mesure of Kaheroux's might and will be useful to overpower opponents during events or win duels. It can be improved by training with the castle's guards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39103775/8d2214e78bb1c0c7d524f5ecef1a6f59d05f5487.jpg[/img]

[b]Knowledge[/b] represents Kaheroux's smarts and wisdom, with it he will be able to better understands the plots of his enemies and foil them. You'll need to spend time in the library to improve it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39103775/b130415cb6ad0d6525db7e9db87f3cc6cb6e14c7.jpg[/img]

Finally [b]Charm [/b]is Kaheroux's good looks and mastery of the words, in a game of seduction this can only be an important matter right... You'll be able to train yourself in it at the market.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39103775/34e417dc8ab75952e47af752ceebc13cd39b0464.jpg[/img]

The three atrributes system make up the core of the gameplay in Leap of Love, by carefully planning your training you'll be able to navigate through the dangerous life of a prince and maybe marry your chosen bride.

[b]Andrealphus[/b]
